Blue island, which is a placeholder for its actual name, is a sub-area, or collection of smaller islands behind the Flowering Meadows. A variety of blue materials, native and not native reside in the area. Waterfalls that go in all directions, floating islands, sparkling blue water, alongside a new temple and cave are in this area.

Notable Locations

  • At the west of the area, there is a medium island shaped like a shooting star.
  • In the east, is a splotch of islands, which range from a turquoise green, (for Blue Pine) and blue (for Blue wisteria).
  • A underwater cave full of giant azurite clusters and new shrooms in the water
  • The Blizzard Bloom shine, essential for the Petalfall

Both of these aren't connected to each other, but are connected closely to the Flowering Meadows.

Star island

  • Has 2 layers, the outermost layer, with Blue Pine and the same turquoise green as the islands, and the inner layer with Blue Wisterias.
